pool.text: In a test of independence with total sample \( N = 358 \), row total \( 73 \), and column total \( 62 \) (Experiment 1), find the expected cell count.
pool.sol: Expected frequency: \( E = \frac{\text{Row Total} \times \text{Col Total}}{\text{Grand Total}} = \frac{73 \times 62}{358} = 12.64 \).
